Professional Summary
Digital marketing professional with a strong focus on SEO, paid search, analytics and performance-driven campaigns. Experienced in driving organic traffic growth, optimizing Google Ads spend, and implementing analytics frameworks to measure user acquisition and conversion. Open to relocating to Mumbai or Chennai. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing, Confluence, Linux, Git

- Optimized Google Ads account structure and bidding strategies, reducing cost-per-acquisition by 22% while increasing high-intent conversions.

- Coordinated with content and social teams to amplify top-performing pages through Social Media Marketing, driving incremental organic and referral traffic.

Performance Marketer, Meesho (Nov 2019 - Jun 2023)

- Built reporting templates in Confluence and used Git to version control campaign assets and landing page experiments on Linux-based servers.

- Maintained SEO documentation and process flow in Confluence, and supported technical deployments using Linux and Git workflows.
